survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: This country note is descriptive and does not conduct student-level statistical modeling with an analytic micro-dataset. The figures and indicators are taken from OECD’s Education at a Glance 2025 indicator tables, which are compiled from multiple sources and use OECD/OECD-collection methodologies for each indicator. Because no student-level regression/ML estimation is performed in this note, complex survey weights (e.g., student sampling weights or replicate weights) are not applied or reported here. For users who access the underlying Education at a Glance 2025 indicator methodology and technical notes, the appropriate weighting and scaling procedures are specified per indicator rather than in this country note.

data.handling_not_reported_explanation: This document is a country note summarizing education-system indicators (e.g., attainment, unemployment by education level, expenditure per student) rather than analyzing cognitive achievement outcomes from ILSA-style assessments with plausible values. As a result, plausible values handling is not applicable because there is no PV-based achievement score modeling in the note. Missing-data handling is not reported here because the note does not present an original estimation model or an analytic dataset with missingness procedures; instead it reports already-produced OECD indicators.

sample_details.sample_filtering_criteria: This is a descriptive OECD country note for Bulgaria based on the latest available year in Education at a Glance 2025 indicator tables. No student-level analytic subsample is defined in the note; it reports indicator values drawn from OECD’s compiled data sources and corresponding indicator-specific methodologies.

data.outcome_summary: This OECD Education at a Glance 2025 country note for Bulgaria provides a descriptive overview of education-system characteristics, with emphasis on tertiary education. It reports system-level indicators such as trends in unemployment among 25–34 year-olds by educational attainment, employment and wage differences by degree level, participation/progression measures (e.g., over-age in lower secondary, entry pathways into tertiary), international student mobility, and public expenditure per student by education level. The note does not analyze student microdata, does not estimate models, and does not report ML performance metrics or causal effects. Instead, it points readers to the corresponding Education at a Glance 2025 indicator tables and technical notes for the underlying data sources, indicator definitions, and methodological details. Therefore, the “benchmarks” are OECD averages and cross-country comparisons presented in the figures, not statistical model outputs from this document.
data.null_fields_interpretation: The extraction is sparse because this document is not an empirical ML/predictive study and does not provide an analytic sample, PV-based outcomes, or model-based results. It is a descriptive indicator note that summarizes already-compiled OECD statistics for Bulgaria, so fields such as total_students, per-country student counts, and ML techniques are not applicable to the note’s content. The methodological details relevant to indicator construction are deferred to the Education at a Glance 2025 Sources, Methodologies and Technical Notes referenced in the text.
